title: China Property Woes Bring Strains to Huafa’s $62 Billion of Debt
reason: 地产困境拖累华发620亿美元债务，中国国企地产信用风险蔓延
summary: 珠海华发集团有两款信托产品逾期兑付，并请求至少三家银行展期贷款。公司有息负债4130亿元，是自万科约一年前展期以来，最大的高度依赖地产的企业寻求延后还款，显示房地产债务困境仍在扩散。

paragraphs.text: Zhuhai Huafa Group Co. missed payments on two trust products and is asking to extend loans from at least three banks due to debt struggles.
The company has 413 billion yuan of interest-bearing liabilities and has developed over 200 residential projects across China, playing a crucial role in the local economy.

Huafa's debt struggles have sparked sharp declines in bonds and shares tied to the group, despite expectations of strong local government support due to its status as a major conglomerate owned by Zhuhai.
China’s unprecedented property crisis has just reached another flashpoint, as one of the country’s biggest local-government owned conglomerates struggles with debt payments.

Based in the southern province of Guangdong, Zhuhai Huafa Group Co. missed payments on two trust products that were due recently, people familiar with the matter said on Monday. The firm, which has helped build landmarks such as the 330-meter tall Zhuhai Tower skyscraper, has also been asking to extend loans from at least three banks.
Zhuhai Tower Photographer: Chen Shuoming/VCG/Getty Images

That makes it the largest company heavily reliant on the property sector to try pushing back debt payments since China Vanke Co., once the country’s biggest developer, took similar steps about a year ago.

The development underscores how China’s years-long real estate debt woes are still spreading despite recent signs of stabilization in the housing market. Huafa has developed over 200 residential projects across China. The conglomerate had 413 billion yuan ($61.9 billion) of interest-bearing liabilities, including bank and trust loans as well as bonds, as of March, according to a company document this month.

“Huafa is facing the same challenges as other Chinese developers, but it also plays such a crucial role in the local economy that local governments are highly likely to step in and support it,” said Yao Yu, chief executive officer and founder of credit research firm RatingDog. “The eventual repayment outlook of Huafa’s bonds is not overly pessimistic.”

Still, the news this week sparked sharp declines in bonds and shares tied to the group, which had just priced a 1 billion yuan note in the domestic market at the relatively low cost of 2.07% only a few days ago.
One of Huafa’s offshore yuan-denominated bonds was last indicated down by a record 17% Tuesday, bringing it to about 74% of face value.
Shares of Zhuhai Huafa Properties Co., the real estate arm of Huafa Group, fell as much as 8.9% in Shanghai Tuesday, to the lowest intra-day level in more than a month.

Unlike Vanke, which is only partially backed by a state-owned firm in Shenzhen, Huafa is wholly owned by the Guangdong government, with Zhuhai’s State-Owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission holding about 93.5% and the provincial finance department owning the remainder.

Local rating firm China Lianhe Credit Rating affirmed Huafa’s AAA rating earlier this year, despite its heavy debt burden, weakening profitability and its high reliance on external financing. The credit assessor cited expectations of strong local government support, given Huafa’s status as a major conglomerate owned by Zhuhai.

After a downward spiral for five years, China’s home prices fell at a slower pace last month, fueling hopes that the property market is turning a corner. China’s government recently turned to mortgage subsidies and changes to bank lending policies to step up efforts to support the economy.

Huafa, which derived about half of its revenue from property development and urban operations last year while also running businesses spanning financial services and technology, had blamed the property downturn as the main reason for its profitability swings.
It reported a total loss of 16.9 billion yuan last year and had about 765 billion yuan in total assets as of March.

“Local government-backed Chinese developers are likely to remain under pressure amid weak homebuyer sentiment, falling property sales and limited fiscal capacity at many regional governments,” said Andrew Chan, credit analyst at Bloomberg Intelligence. “Unlike centrally backed SOEs, they face weaker funding access and refinancing support.”

target.text: China’s unprecedented property crisis has just reached another flashpoint, as one of the country’s biggest local-government owned conglomerates struggles with debt payments.

annotations.translationZh: 中国史无前例的房地产危机刚刚又到了一个爆发点：该国最大的地方国有综合企业集团之一正深陷偿债困境。

structure.text: China’s unprecedented property crisis
has just reached another flashpoint
structure.note: 现在完成时 + just，强调“刚刚发生、影响仍在”

structure.text: as one of the country’s biggest local-government owned conglomerates struggles with debt payments
structure.note: as 既交代原因又交代同时发生的背景，新闻导语常用

annotations.explanation: 典型新闻导语句：先给“大判断”（危机到了新节点），再用 as 从句交代具体事件。as 在这里兼有“因为”和“与此同时”的意味，比 because 更客观、更像报道语气。写概括性开头时可以模仿“X has reached another Y, as Z ...”。

examples.en: Tensions in the region have reached a new high, as both sides refuse to back down.
examples.zh: 地区紧张局势达到新高，因为双方都拒绝让步。

annotations.meaningZh: 又到了一个爆发点；危机再度激化
annotations.explanation: flashpoint 原指“燃点”，引申为冲突或危机一触即发的节点；reach a flashpoint 是新闻里描述局势激化的固定搭配。another 暗示此前已有过多次危机节点，带出“危机延绵不断”的态度。

examples.en: The long-running dispute over water rights reached a flashpoint last summer.
examples.zh: 持续已久的水权纠纷去年夏天激化到了临界点。

annotations.notes: 近义：come to a head（矛盾激化）、boil over（沸腾、失控）

annotations.explanation: 指业务横跨多个不相关行业的大型集团（华发既做地产，也做金融、科技）。财经报道高频词；注意与 group、holding company 的区别：conglomerate 强调“多元、跨界”。

examples.en: The media conglomerate owns newspapers, TV stations and a film studio.
examples.zh: 这家传媒集团旗下有报纸、电视台和一家电影公司。

annotations.meaningZh: 难以按时偿债；在偿债上陷入困境
annotations.explanation: struggle with 表示“在某事上苦苦挣扎、应付不来”，比 have problems with 更有画面感。debt payments 指到期需支付的本息。新闻常用 struggle with debt / struggle with losses。

examples.en: Many small businesses are struggling with rising rents.
examples.zh: 许多小企业正苦于租金上涨。

annotations.explanation: 过去分词短语置于句首作状语，交代机构所在地，是新闻介绍公司的标准写法，比 “Zhuhai Huafa, which is based in…” 更紧凑。注意逻辑主语必须是后面的主句主语（Zhuhai Huafa Group）。

examples.en: Based in Berlin, the startup has raised $20 million so far.
examples.zh: 这家总部位于柏林的初创公司迄今已融资 2000 万美元。

annotations.meaningZh: 未能按期付款；（债务）违约支付
annotations.explanation: miss 的熟词僻义：不是“想念/错过车”，而是“未能按时支付”。missed payment 在信用和债务语境中是关键信号词，比 default（正式违约）程度略轻，常是违约的前兆。

examples.en: Two missed payments can seriously damage your credit score.
examples.zh: 两次逾期还款就可能严重损害你的信用评分。

annotations.notes: 辨析：miss a payment（逾期一次）→ default on a loan（正式违约）

annotations.explanation: 中国金融语境的专业词：信托公司发行、向投资者募资的理财产品，常为房企融资通道。trust 在这里是“信托”而非“信任”，属于熟词僻义。

examples.en: Investors in several trust products have not received their principal on time.
examples.zh: 多款信托产品的投资者未能按时收回本金。

annotations.explanation: due 在财经语境指“到期应支付的”：payments that were due = 到期的款项。常见搭配 be due（到期）、fall due（到期）、overdue（逾期的）。不要与 due to（由于）混淆。

examples.en: The first installment is due at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 第一期款项月底到期。

target.text: people familiar with the matter said

annotations.explanation: 彭博、路透等报道匿名消息源的固定说法，读者看到它就知道信息来自非公开渠道。类似框架：according to people with knowledge of the situation / sources close to the company。写作中可借用来引出未经官方证实的信息。

examples.en: The deal could be announced as early as next week, people familiar with the matter said.
examples.zh: 知情人士称，这笔交易最早可能于下周宣布。

target.text: The firm, which has helped build landmarks such as the 330-meter tall Zhuhai Tower skyscraper, has also been asking to extend loans from at least three banks.

annotations.translationZh: 这家曾参与建造 330 米高的珠海中心大厦等地标建筑的公司，还一直在向至少三家银行申请贷款展期。

structure.text: The firm
which has helped build landmarks such as the 330-meter tall Zhuhai Tower skyscraper
structure.note: 插入背景信息，help do 省略 to

structure.text: has also been asking to extend loans from at least three banks
structure.note: 现在完成进行时，强调这一行为从过去持续到现在

annotations.explanation: 主谓之间插入很长的非限定性定语从句，读时要先找到主干 The firm … has also been asking to extend loans。现在完成进行时 has been asking 说明“申请展期”不是一次性动作而是持续进行中。330-meter tall 是“数字-单位”复合形容词，单位用单数。

examples.en: The company, which was founded in a garage in 1998, now employs over 5,000 people.
examples.zh: 这家 1998 年在车库里创立的公司，如今雇员超过 5000 人。

annotations.meaningZh: 贷款展期；延长贷款期限
annotations.explanation: extend 原义“延长、伸展”，这里指把贷款还款期限往后推，即“展期”。注意 extend a loan to sb 也可表示“向某人发放贷款”，需看语境。本句 extend loans from banks = 让银行同意延期。

examples.en: The bank agreed to extend the loan by another 12 months.
examples.zh: 银行同意将这笔贷款再展期 12 个月。

annotations.notes: 相关：roll over a loan（借新还旧/续贷）、restructure debt（债务重组）

target.text: That makes it the largest company heavily reliant on the property sector to try pushing back debt payments since China Vanke Co., once the country’s biggest developer, took similar steps about a year ago.

annotations.translationZh: 这使它成为自约一年前曾为中国最大开发商的万科采取类似措施以来，试图推迟偿债的最大一家高度依赖房地产业的企业。

structure.text: That
structure.note: 指代上一段的事件

structure.text: makes it the largest company
structure.note: make + 宾语 + 名词作宾补

structure.text: heavily reliant on the property sector
structure.note: 形容词短语修饰 company

structure.text: to try pushing back debt payments
structure.note: 不定式修饰 the largest company，“the + 最高级 + 名词 + to do”

structure.text: since China Vanke Co., once the country’s biggest developer, took similar steps about a year ago
structure.note: since 限定最高级的比较范围

structure.text: once the country’s biggest developer
structure.note: once 意为“曾经”

annotations.explanation: 新闻常用“the largest/first … to do … since …”句式来衡量事件的分量：最高级 + 不定式后置定语 + since 从句限定时间范围。once the country’s biggest developer 是用 once（曾经）引导的同位语，简洁交代万科的身份。翻译时要把长定语提前，按中文习惯重组。

examples.en: She is the first woman to win the award since it was created in 1950.
examples.zh: 她是该奖项自 1950 年设立以来首位获奖的女性。

annotations.explanation: reliant on = dependent on，常与程度副词 heavily / highly 搭配。名词形式 reliance on 在本文 p15 再次出现（high reliance on external financing），可以对照学习词性转换。

examples.en: The island is heavily reliant on tourism.
examples.zh: 这座岛高度依赖旅游业。

annotations.explanation: push back 在这里是“推迟（时间/期限）”，等于 postpone / delay，口语和新闻都很常用。另一常见义为“反对、抵制”（push back against a plan），需靠语境区分。

examples.en: We had to push back the launch date by two weeks.
examples.zh: 我们不得不把发布日期推迟两周。

annotations.notes: 多义：push back（推迟）/ push back against（反对）

annotations.explanation: 熟词语境义：在地产新闻中 developer 专指“开发商”，而不是“软件开发者”。property developer / real estate developer 是完整说法。

examples.en: The developer plans to build 500 new homes on the site.
examples.zh: 开发商计划在这块地上建 500 套新房。

annotations.explanation: take steps 是“采取措施”的地道搭配，比 do something 正式；常见扩展 take steps to do、take decisive steps。similar 回指前文“推迟偿债”，避免重复。

examples.en: The government has taken steps to curb speculation in the housing market.
examples.zh: 政府已采取措施遏制楼市投机。

target.text: The development underscores how China’s years-long real estate debt woes are still spreading despite recent signs of stabilization in the housing market.

annotations.translationZh: 这一事态凸显出，尽管楼市近来出现企稳迹象，中国持续多年的房地产债务困境仍在蔓延。

structure.text: The development
structure.note: development = 事态发展

structure.text: underscores
how China’s years-long real estate debt woes are still spreading
structure.note: how 引导，意为“……的情况/程度”

structure.text: despite recent signs of stabilization in the housing market
structure.note: despite + 名词短语

annotations.explanation: “The development/move/news underscores how …”是新闻分析段的经典开头：先指代上文事件，再引出它说明的更大趋势。how 引导宾语从句时不一定是“如何”，常译为“……的事实/程度”。despite 引出与主句相反的事实，构成转折张力。

examples.en: The incident underscores how fragile global supply chains remain.
examples.zh: 这一事件凸显出全球供应链依然多么脆弱。

annotations.explanation: 熟词僻义：新闻中 the development 常指“刚刚发生的事件/新进展”，用来回指上文，而不是“发展/开发”。类似回指词：the move、the episode、the news。

examples.en: We will keep you updated on any further developments.
examples.zh: 如有进一步进展，我们会及时通知你。

annotations.explanation: 原义“在下面划线”，引申为“突出说明”，比 shows 更有分析色彩，新闻评论高频。同义：highlight、underline、point to。

examples.en: The report underscores the need for urgent reform.
examples.zh: 这份报告凸显了紧急改革的必要性。

annotations.explanation: 复合形容词：名词复数 years + long，表示持续时间长。注意这里保留复数（years-long），而具体数字时用单数（a five-year-long project）。类似：decades-long、months-long。

examples.en: The decades-long conflict finally came to an end.
examples.zh: 这场持续数十年的冲突终于结束了。

annotations.explanation: woes 多用复数，指一连串的困难，带有书面和新闻色彩，标题里极常见（debt woes、economic woes）。比 problems 更凝练、更有情绪。

examples.en: The airline’s financial woes deepened after the strike.
examples.zh: 罢工后这家航空公司的财务困境进一步加深。

annotations.explanation: signs of + 名词 是描述趋势的常用框架（signs of recovery / slowdown / life）。stabilization 是 stabilize 的名词，财经报道描述市场“止跌企稳”的标准词。

examples.en: The labor market is showing signs of stabilization.
examples.zh: 劳动力市场显示出企稳迹象。

annotations.explanation: 财报专业术语：需要支付利息的债务（银行贷款、债券、信托借款等），衡量企业真实债务压力比总负债更准。-bearing 意为“带有……的”，同构词：interest-bearing account（计息账户）。

examples.en: The company aims to cut its interest-bearing debt by 20% this year.
examples.zh: 公司计划今年将有息负债削减 20%。

annotations.explanation: as of 表示“截至某时”，财报和统计数据的必备搭配，常与 according to 连用交代数据来源与时间点。注意不要写成 until March。

examples.en: As of June 30, the fund managed $3 billion in assets.
examples.zh: 截至 6 月 30 日，该基金管理着 30 亿美元资产。

target.text: Huafa is facing the same challenges as other Chinese developers, but it also plays such a crucial role in the local economy that local governments are highly likely to step in and support it

annotations.translationZh: 华发面临着与其他中国开发商同样的挑战，但它在地方经济中的作用如此关键，地方政府极有可能出手相助。

structure.text: Huafa is facing the same challenges as other Chinese developers
structure.note: the same … as … 比较结构

structure.text: but it also plays such a crucial role in the local economy
structure.note: such + a + adj. + n.

structure.text: that local governments are highly likely to step in and support it
structure.note: such … that … 如此……以至于

annotations.explanation: 两个值得学的结构：the same … as …（与……相同）和 such a/an + 形容词 + 名词 + that（如此……以至于）。注意 such 修饰名词短语，so 修饰形容词（so crucial that）。but 前后构成“同样有难处，但有靠山”的让步逻辑，是分析师评论的常见论证方式。

examples.en: It was such a beautiful day that we decided to eat outside.
examples.zh: 天气那么好，我们决定在外面吃饭。

target.text: plays such a crucial role in

annotations.meaningZh: 在……中扮演如此关键的角色
annotations.explanation: play a (key/crucial/vital) role in 是表达“起……作用”的核心搭配，写作必备。本句把 a crucial role 嵌入 such … that 结构，演示了固定搭配如何与句型组合。

examples.en: Teachers play a vital role in shaping children’s values.
examples.zh: 教师在塑造孩子价值观方面起着至关重要的作用。

annotations.explanation: 表推测的程度词块：highly likely > likely > possible。分析师用它表达有把握但不绝对的判断。不要说 very likely to 时显得口语，highly likely 更正式。

examples.en: Interest rates are highly likely to rise next quarter.
examples.zh: 下季度利率极有可能上调。

annotations.explanation: step in 指在困难时“介入、出手相救”，政府救助、监管干预语境高频。近义：intervene（更正式）、come to the rescue。

examples.en: The central bank stepped in to stabilize the currency.
examples.zh: 央行出手稳定汇率。

annotations.explanation: outlook 指“前景、展望”，评级机构术语（rating outlook：评级展望 stable / negative / positive）。repayment outlook 即债券最终能否偿付的预期。

examples.en: Analysts have a positive outlook for the sector.
examples.zh: 分析师看好这一行业的前景。

annotations.explanation: not overly 是委婉的“弱否定”表达（litotes），比直接说 optimistic 更克制谨慎，体现分析师留有余地的语气。overly = excessively，常见 not overly concerned / surprised。

examples.en: I’m not overly worried about the test.
examples.zh: 我并不太担心这次考试。

annotations.notes: 表达态度的弱化手段：not overly、not entirely、by no means certain

annotations.explanation: 句首 Still + 逗号 是转折连接副词，意为“尽管如此”，用来引出与上文（分析师相对乐观）相反的事实。熟词僻义，别误解为“仍然、静止”。同义：Even so、Nevertheless。

examples.en: The hotel was expensive. Still, the view was worth it.
examples.zh: 酒店很贵。不过，那景色值了。

target.text: Still, the news this week sparked sharp declines in bonds and shares tied to the group, which had just priced a 1 billion yuan note in the domestic market at the relatively low cost of 2.07% only a few days ago.

annotations.translationZh: 尽管如此，本周的消息还是引发了该集团相关债券和股票的大跌，而就在几天前，该集团刚刚在境内市场以 2.07% 的较低成本完成了一笔 10 亿元票据的定价。

structure.text: Still
the news this week
sparked sharp declines in bonds and shares tied to the group
structure.note: tied to the group 为过去分词后置定语

structure.text: which had just priced a 1 billion yuan note in the domestic market at the relatively low cost of 2.07% only a few days ago
structure.note: 过去完成时 had just priced，强调发生在“大跌”之前，形成反差

annotations.explanation: 这句话的精髓在于时态对比：主句一般过去时 sparked（本周大跌），从句过去完成时 had just priced（几天前还低成本融资），制造“几天之间急转直下”的戏剧反差。which 指代 the group。

examples.en: He failed the exam, which surprised everyone because he had studied hard for months.
examples.zh: 他考试没过，大家都很意外，因为他已苦读了几个月。

annotations.explanation: spark 原义“火花”，作动词表示“引发、触发”（spark protests / a debate / a sell-off），比 cause 更生动。sharp declines 是描述价格急跌的标准搭配，反义 sharp gains。

examples.en: The announcement sparked a sell-off in tech stocks.
examples.zh: 这一宣布引发了科技股抛售。

annotations.explanation: 过去分词短语作后置定语：bonds and shares tied to the group = 与该集团相关的债券和股票。tied to 也常表示“与……挂钩”（pay tied to performance）。

examples.en: Her bonus is tied to the company’s annual profits.
examples.zh: 她的奖金与公司年度利润挂钩。

annotations.explanation: 熟词僻义：price 作动词在债券市场指“确定发行利率并完成定价”，price a bond / note 基本等于“发行成功”。与名词“价格”区分。

examples.en: The company priced its IPO at the top of the expected range.
examples.zh: 公司以预期区间上限为 IPO 定价。

annotations.explanation: 熟词僻义：财经语境 note 是一种债务工具（期限较短的债券），而非“笔记、便条”。常见 medium-term note（中期票据）、Treasury note（美国中期国债）。

examples.en: The government issued 10-year notes worth $40 billion.
examples.zh: 政府发行了价值 400 亿美元的十年期国债。

annotations.explanation: 金融语境中 offshore 指“境外市场的”，与 domestic / onshore（境内）相对；offshore yuan 即离岸人民币（CNH）。原义“近海的”（offshore wind farm）。

examples.en: The company raised funds through an offshore bond sale.
examples.zh: 公司通过境外发债筹集了资金。

annotations.explanation: X-denominated 表示“以 X 货币计价的”，财经复合词高频（dollar-denominated debt 美元债）。denominate 本义“命名、以……为单位”。

examples.en: Many emerging markets struggle with dollar-denominated debt.
examples.zh: 许多新兴市场深受美元债困扰。

target.text: One of Huafa’s offshore yuan-denominated bonds was last indicated down by a record 17% Tuesday, bringing it to about 74% of face value.

annotations.translationZh: 华发一只离岸人民币债券周二最新报价下跌了创纪录的 17%，跌至面值的约 74%。

structure.text: One of Huafa’s offshore yuan-denominated bonds
was last indicated down by a record 17%
structure.note: 被动；indicated = 报价显示；down by 表示跌幅

structure.text: Tuesday
structure.note: 美式新闻中星期前常省略 on

structure.text: bringing it to about 74% of face value
structure.note: 现在分词短语表结果

annotations.explanation: 学三点：① by 表示变化幅度（down by 17%），to 表示变化后的结果（bringing it to 74%），这对介词描述数据时极易混用；② 句末 -ing 分词短语表示自然结果；③ record 作形容词“创纪录的”。描述图表趋势作文可以直接套用。

examples.en: Sales rose by 12% last year, bringing the total to $5 million.
examples.zh: 去年销售额增长 12%，使总额达到 500 万美元。

annotations.explanation: 债券的票面金额；价格跌到面值的 74% 意味着市场担忧偿付。另有引申义 take sth at face value（只看表面、信以为真），日常很常用。

examples.en: Don’t take everything he says at face value.
examples.zh: 别把他说的每句话都当真。

annotations.explanation: 熟词僻义：arm 指大公司的“分支、业务部门”（the real estate arm = 地产板块子公司）。类似：investment arm、lending arm。

examples.en: The bank’s investment arm reported record profits.
examples.zh: 该银行的投资部门利润创下纪录。

annotations.explanation: as much as 强调“多达”，股价报道中表示盘中最大跌幅（不一定是收盘跌幅），与 closed down（收盘下跌）不同。描述上涨可用 rose as much as。

examples.en: The stock rose as much as 15% before paring gains.
examples.zh: 该股一度大涨 15%，随后涨幅收窄。

annotations.explanation: intra- 前缀“在……之内”：intra-day 即同一交易日之内。lowest intra-day level 指盘中最低点。同前缀：intranet（内网）、intra-company。

examples.en: The index hit an intraday high before falling back.
examples.zh: 指数盘中创下新高后回落。

target.text: Unlike Vanke, which is only partially backed by a state-owned firm in Shenzhen, Huafa is wholly owned by the Guangdong government, with Zhuhai’s State-Owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission holding about 93.5% and the provincial finance department owning the remainder.

annotations.translationZh: 与仅由深圳一家国企部分持股的万科不同，华发由广东地方政府全资拥有，其中珠海市国资委持股约 93.5%，其余由省财政厅持有。

structure.text: Unlike Vanke, which is only partially backed by a state-owned firm in Shenzhen
structure.note: unlike + 名词 + 非限定性定语从句

structure.text: Huafa is wholly owned by the Guangdong government
with Zhuhai’s State-Owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission holding about 93.5% and the provincial finance department owning the remainder
structure.note: with + 名词 + 现在分词，补充说明股权构成

annotations.explanation: 长句骨架是 Unlike A, B is …, with C doing … and D doing …。with 独立结构把两个补充细节并列挂在句尾，非常适合写数据构成。partially 与 wholly 形成对比，是作者论证“华发更有政府背书”的关键词。

examples.en: The team won the game, with Smith scoring two goals and Lee adding one.
examples.zh: 球队赢了比赛，史密斯进了两球，李又进一球。

annotations.explanation: back 作动词“支持、背书”，be backed by the state 是讨论国企信用的高频说法；state-backed、government-backed 是对应复合形容词（见 p19）。partially 与后文 wholly 对照。

examples.en: The project is backed by several major investors.
examples.zh: 该项目得到了几家大投资者的支持。

annotations.explanation: 公司法常用词：wholly owned subsidiary（全资子公司）。wholly = completely，与 partially / majority-owned（控股）构成持股程度梯度。

examples.en: It operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of the parent company.
examples.zh: 它作为母公司的全资子公司运营。

target.text: State-Owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission

annotations.meaningZh: 国有资产监督管理委员会（国资委）
annotations.explanation: 中国特有机构的英文官方译名，缩写 SASAC。读中国财经英文报道必须认得；地方国资委写作 city/provincial SASAC。

examples.en: The SASAC oversees China’s largest state-owned enterprises.
examples.zh: 国资委监管中国最大的国有企业。

annotations.explanation: the remainder 指“剩下的部分”，用来交代比例的其余部分，比 the rest 更正式。the remainder of + 名词 也常用（the remainder of the year）。

examples.en: Half the budget goes to salaries, and the remainder to equipment.
examples.zh: 一半预算用于工资，其余用于设备。

annotations.explanation: 评级术语：affirm a rating = 维持原评级不变，与 upgrade（上调）、downgrade（下调）并列。日常义为“断言、肯定”。

examples.en: Moody’s affirmed the country’s A1 rating with a stable outlook.
examples.zh: 穆迪维持该国 A1 评级，展望稳定。

annotations.explanation: heavy 修饰 burden 是固定搭配，还可说 crushing / mounting debt burden。burden 是本句列举的三个负面因素之一，体现评级机构“虽有隐忧仍维持”的让步逻辑。

examples.en: The country is struggling under a heavy debt burden.
examples.zh: 该国在沉重的债务负担下苦苦挣扎。

annotations.explanation: reliance on 是 reliant on（p8）的名词形式；external financing 指借款、发债等外部资金来源，与 internal funds（自有资金）相对，是评估企业脆弱性的指标。

examples.en: Reducing reliance on imported energy is a national priority.
examples.zh: 减少对进口能源的依赖是国家优先事项。

target.text: The credit assessor cited expectations of strong local government support, given Huafa’s status as a major conglomerate owned by Zhuhai.

annotations.translationZh: 鉴于华发作为珠海市属大型综合集团的地位，该评级机构提到了对地方政府强力支持的预期。

structure.text: The credit assessor
structure.note: 同义替换 China Lianhe Credit Rating，避免重复

structure.text: cited expectations of strong local government support
structure.note: cite = 援引作为理由

structure.text: given Huafa’s status as a major conglomerate owned by Zhuhai
structure.note: given + 名词，意为“考虑到”

annotations.explanation: 两个写作技巧：① 新闻用 the credit assessor 回指前句的评级公司，是避免重复的同义替换；② given 作介词表“鉴于、考虑到”，比 because of 简洁正式，可接名词或 given that 从句。cite 表示“援引……作为理由”。

examples.en: Given the weather, the match was postponed.
examples.zh: 考虑到天气，比赛被推迟了。

target.text: After a downward spiral for five years, China’s home prices fell at a slower pace last month, fueling hopes that the property market is turning a corner.

annotations.translationZh: 在持续五年螺旋式下跌之后，中国房价上月跌幅收窄，令人们燃起楼市正在好转的希望。

structure.text: After a downward spiral for five years
China’s home prices fell at a slower pace last month
structure.note: at a slower pace 说明是“跌得慢了”，不是上涨

structure.text: fueling hopes that the property market is turning a corner
structure.note: 现在分词表结果；that 从句为 hopes 的同位语从句

annotations.explanation: 注意逻辑细节：fell at a slower pace 仍是下跌，只是速度放缓，却已被解读为“拐点”——作者借此暗示市场情绪先于基本面。fueling hopes that … 中 that 引导同位语从句解释 hopes 的内容。

examples.en: Inflation eased slightly in May, fueling hopes that rate cuts are coming.
examples.zh: 5 月通胀略有缓和，令人们燃起降息将至的希望。

annotations.meaningZh: 螺旋式下滑；恶性循环下跌
annotations.explanation: spiral 原指螺旋，downward spiral 比喻不断自我强化的下滑（价格跌→需求弱→再跌）。可用于经济、健康、关系等多种语境。

examples.en: Losing his job sent him into a downward spiral of debt and depression.
examples.zh: 失业让他陷入债务和抑郁的恶性循环。

annotations.explanation: fuel 作动词“助长、激起”，常搭配 fuel hopes / fears / speculation / inflation。比 increase 更形象，新闻高频。

examples.en: Strong earnings fueled speculation about a takeover.
examples.zh: 强劲的业绩引发了外界对收购的猜测。

annotations.explanation: 比喻“拐过最艰难的弯”，表示情况开始好转，常用于经济、病情、公司经营。进行时 is turning a corner 表示“正在好转中”，语气仍带不确定。

examples.en: After months of losses, the company seems to have turned a corner.
examples.zh: 在亏损数月之后，公司似乎出现了转机。

annotations.explanation: turn to 表示“转向（某种手段）求助”，暗示之前的方法不够用。turn to mortgage subsidies = 转而采用房贷补贴。另义 turn to sb for help（向某人求助）。

examples.en: When sales slowed, the firm turned to online marketing.
examples.zh: 销售放缓后，公司转向线上营销。

annotations.explanation: step up 意为“加强、加大”，step up efforts / pressure / production 都是常用搭配，比 increase efforts 更地道。注意与 p10 的 step in（介入）区分。

examples.en: Police have stepped up efforts to tackle street crime.
examples.zh: 警方加大了打击街头犯罪的力度。

annotations.notes: 辨析：step up（加大力度）/ step in（介入）/ step down（辞职）

target.text: Huafa, which derived about half of its revenue from property development and urban operations last year while also running businesses spanning financial services and technology, had blamed the property downturn as the main reason for its profitability swings.

annotations.translationZh: 华发去年约一半收入来自房地产开发和城市运营，同时还经营涵盖金融服务和科技的业务；该公司此前将盈利波动的主要原因归咎于房地产下行。

structure.text: Huafa
which derived about half of its revenue from property development and urban operations last year
structure.note: derive … from … 来自

structure.text: while also running businesses spanning financial services and technology
structure.note: while + -ing；spanning 为分词作后置定语

structure.text: had blamed the property downturn as the main reason for its profitability swings
structure.note: 过去完成时表示此前已有的说法

annotations.explanation: 主语和谓语被 40 多词的插入成分隔开，阅读时要抓住 Huafa … had blamed …。while also running 表示同时进行；spanning 意为“横跨”，修饰 businesses。过去完成时 had blamed 说明这是公司早先的解释，暗含“现在问题不止于此”。

examples.en: The museum, which attracts millions of visitors each year while also hosting research programs, has received new funding.
examples.zh: 这家每年吸引数百万游客、同时承办研究项目的博物馆获得了新资助。

annotations.explanation: derive sth from sth 表示“从……获得/取得”，财报中 derive revenue from 是描述收入来源的标准说法。也常见被动 be derived from（源于）。

examples.en: The company derives most of its income from advertising.
examples.zh: 公司大部分收入来自广告。

annotations.explanation: span 作动词表示“跨越（范围或时间）”，businesses spanning X and Y = 业务横跨 X 和 Y。也用于时间：a career spanning 40 years。

examples.en: Her research spans biology, chemistry and computer science.
examples.zh: 她的研究横跨生物、化学和计算机科学。

annotations.explanation: 指经济或行业的下滑期，比 recession（衰退）范围更宽、程度可轻可重。常用搭配 economic downturn、property downturn；反义 upturn。

examples.en: Many retailers closed stores during the downturn.
examples.zh: 经济下行期间，许多零售商关闭了门店。

annotations.explanation: swing 原义“摆动”，名词指数值的大幅波动（mood swings / price swings）。profitability swings 表示利润忽高忽低，本句为委婉说法，实际是巨额亏损（见下一段）。

examples.en: The company has seen wild swings in quarterly earnings.
examples.zh: 公司季度盈利波动剧烈。

annotations.explanation: report 在财报语境中是“公布（业绩）”，report a loss / profit / net income 是固定搭配，相当于中文“录得、实现”。

examples.en: The airline reported a net loss of $200 million for the quarter.
examples.zh: 这家航空公司公布季度净亏损 2 亿美元。

target.text: Local government-backed Chinese developers are likely to remain under pressure amid weak homebuyer sentiment, falling property sales and limited fiscal capacity at many regional governments,

annotations.translationZh: 由于购房者情绪低迷、房产销售下滑以及许多地方政府财力有限，地方政府背景的中国开发商可能继续承压。

structure.text: Local government-backed Chinese developers
structure.note: government-backed 复合形容词

structure.text: are likely to remain under pressure
structure.note: be likely to 表推测

structure.text: amid weak homebuyer sentiment, falling property sales and limited fiscal capacity at many regional governments
structure.note: amid + 三个并列名词短语

annotations.explanation: amid 引出三个并列的不利背景，是分析师罗列原因的高效句式：形容词 + 名词 ×3（weak sentiment / falling sales / limited capacity），结构整齐。写观点作文可以仿写“X is likely to remain Y amid A, B and C”。

examples.en: Airlines are likely to remain cautious amid high fuel costs, weak demand and staff shortages.
examples.zh: 在燃油成本高企、需求疲弱和人手短缺的背景下，航空公司可能继续保持谨慎。

annotations.explanation: under pressure 表示“承受压力”，remain 强调状态延续。股价、货币、行业都可“承压”，是财经评论中的高频结论语。

examples.en: The pound is expected to remain under pressure this week.
examples.zh: 预计英镑本周将继续承压。

annotations.explanation: amid 是新闻最爱的介词之一，表示“在……（通常是不利）的环境中”，同时暗含因果。比 because of 更客观，比 during 多了因果意味。

examples.en: Stocks fell amid fears of a global recession.
examples.zh: 在对全球衰退的担忧中，股市下跌。

annotations.explanation: sentiment 在财经中指“市场情绪、信心”，而不是“伤感”。常见 market sentiment、investor sentiment、consumer sentiment。

examples.en: Investor sentiment improved after the trade deal.
examples.zh: 贸易协议达成后，投资者情绪好转。

annotations.explanation: fiscal 指“财政的”（政府收支），与 financial（金融的、财务的）区分。fiscal capacity 即政府可动用的财力，直接决定能否救助地方国企。

examples.en: Many cities lack the fiscal capacity to fund new infrastructure.
examples.zh: 许多城市缺乏资助新基础设施的财力。

annotations.notes: 辨析：fiscal（财政）/ monetary（货币）/ financial（金融）

target.text: Unlike centrally backed SOEs, they face weaker funding access and refinancing support.

annotations.translationZh: 与中央背景的国企不同，它们获得融资的渠道和再融资支持都更弱。

structure.text: Unlike centrally backed SOEs
structure.note: centrally backed = 由中央政府支持

structure.text: they face weaker funding access and refinancing support
structure.note: face 抽象用法：面临

annotations.explanation: 用 Unlike 开头的对比句点出“央企 vs 地方国企”的分层，是全文论证落点。SOEs = state-owned enterprises（国有企业）；centrally backed 与 p14 的 partially backed 都是“副词 + backed”结构，可积累。

examples.en: Unlike large chains, independent bookstores face higher costs per sale.
examples.zh: 与大型连锁店不同，独立书店的单笔销售成本更高。

annotations.explanation: access 表示“获得……的机会/途径”，funding access = access to funding。常用 gain / lose / limited access to credit。

examples.en: Small firms often have limited access to bank credit.
examples.zh: 小企业往往难以获得银行信贷。

annotations.explanation: refinance 指借新债还旧债，refinancing support 即银行或政府帮助企业续接到期债务。是理解“债务墙”“展期”等话题的关键概念。

examples.en: The company needs refinancing support before its bonds mature next year.
examples.zh: 公司需要在明年债券到期前获得再融资支持。
